message.reasoning: We need to answer. The question: "Can I build a custom report that groups tickets by tag instead of the default status grouping?" According to policy excerpts: Yes, Reports → Custom → New report lets any report be built around a different grouping, including tag. So answer: Yes, you can. Provide steps: go to Reports > Custom > New report, select Tag as group-by dimension. Also mention that tickets with multiple tags counted once per tag. Provide short answer.

function.arguments: {"message":"Yes – you can. In the Reports section choose Custom → New report, then set the group‑by dimension to Tag. The report will show one row per tag, with the same metrics (count, average resolution time, etc.) as the default status reports. If a ticket has multiple tags it will appear once under each tag."}
